downloads.title: Writing Successful College Application Essays
downloads.blurb: Every 2026–27 Common App prompt, the UC questions, the usual supplements, and how to build a personal narrative. About 40 pages.
downloads.detail: A complete guide to the written part of the U.S. college application. It covers how admissions officers read essays, what a personal narrative needs, and how to handle each prompt your child will face this cycle. Parents tend to read it first and then hand it over.

downloads.blurb: Andrea's workshop deck: do's and don'ts, topics to avoid, structure, style, and the brainstorming questions she asks first. 36 slides.

Thirty-six slides: do's and don'ts, topics to avoid, how to build an introduction, body and conclusion, writing strategies from verb tense to pacing, the 2026 to 2027 Common App prompts, and the brainstorming questions she asks students first.
